title: Put a text's parts together at the end
statement: When one text runs across several lessons, give the last one a task where learners retell or connect the whole, since closing each part alone never asks for it.
example: In the last of four lessons on one story, no rubric criterion across all 21 pages asked for the four parts together.
detail: An audit of the last lesson in a four-lesson reading of one story found that no earlier lesson applied the story pattern to all four parts, each lesson only retrieving from the one before, so the last lesson was the only place the whole could come together (`grade3-reading/artifacts/arc-audit/PEDAGOGY-L7-2026-09-05.md`, lines 170-173). Its retell asked for the last part only, and no criterion in any rubric across all 21 pages asked for the four parts together (lines 175-176 and 257). The audit put the fix at one rubric criterion, a retell extended to the whole story (lines 184-187), and a re-verification confirmed the gap as real, a value-add beyond the design rather than a breach of it, and left the change for a ruling (`grade3-reading/artifacts/arc-audit/REGISTER-PEDAGOGY-2026-09-05.md`, line 19).
against: The design never asked for a whole-text task, only that the pattern's labels show on screen as a reminder, and a film covers the whole: "The video carries the arc framing." (`grade3-reading/artifacts/arc-audit/PEDAGOGY-L7-2026-09-05.md`, lines 180-183). The audit rated the gap minor, and nothing measured whether learners join the parts without such a task.

evidence.quote: No prior lesson in the arc explicitly synthesizes the full "we-meet / they-want / but / so / then" pattern against all four parts (only p0 of each lesson retrieves from the prior one). L7 is the only lesson that *could* deliver this whole-arc synthesis.
the child never produces a whole-arc synthesis. The retell (p19) asks for Part 4, not all four parts.
no criterion in any rubric across all 21 pages asks for Parts 1-4 synthesis
would cost one rubric criterion change and deliver the full arc-closure payoff
